label: Mountain
summary: Alpine mountains grown by their rivers: sharp crests, valleys branching up every slope, scree under the cliffs and snow above a line.

inputs.name: area
inputs.label: Area
inputs.help: Where the mountains stand; everywhere when left empty.

exposed.name: seed
exposed.label: Seed
exposed.help: Another seed gives other mountains of the same kind.

exposed.name: height
exposed.label: Mountain height
exposed.help: How high the summits rise over the foot, in blocks.

exposed.name: base
exposed.label: Foot
exposed.help: The height of the ground at the mountains' foot, in blocks.

exposed.name: spacing
exposed.label: Peak spacing
exposed.help: How far apart the summits stand, in blocks: smaller makes more, narrower mountains.

exposed.name: roughness
exposed.label: Roughness
exposed.help: How much small relief the slopes carry before the rivers wear them.

exposed.name: erosion
exposed.label: Erosion strength
exposed.help: How deep the rivers cut their valleys.

exposed.name: snowline
exposed.label: Snow line
exposed.help: The height above which snow lies on open ground, in blocks.
